text:
aj: Quick question — saw a short 502 spike around 2026-02-12T20:30Z. Ingress logs show a bunch of `kvcache timeout` lines. Where's the best place to grab correlated traces + a per-route 502 dashboard so I can assemble samples for postmortem and decide on alert debounce?

maria: For dashboards, open Observability > Errors > "502 by route" (Grafana). quick link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/err/502-by-route (works SSO). For logs: use the main logging UI and run this filter: `service:ingress AND status:502 AND message:/kvcache.*timeout/` — that should surface the raw requests + trace id field.

leo: For traces, query tempo/jaeger with `trace.tag=http.status_code:502` then filter by span.name contains `ingress` or `kvcache`. If you want a compact search: click the trace id from logs and open trace view.

aj: thanks — can you paste the exact log query I should paste into the logging UI? and any dashboard panels to bookmark?

maria: log query (copy/paste):
```
service=ingress status=502 message~"kvcache" | json | sort -ts -r | limit 100
```
Panels to bookmark: 
- 502 by route (panel id 7)
- Prefix cache timeout trend (panel id 42)
- Ingress latency heatmap (panel id 12)
(links from the grafana view have anchors, e.g. add `?viewPanel=7` to share a panel)

denise: If these are kvcache-related timeouts, we should be cautious about reducing debounce too much. Suggest bumping the alert debounce to 3m from 1m for the ingress 502 alert while we investigate. I'll open a quick PR if folks agree.

aj: +1 to a temporary bump. Also want to collect ~10 example traces (span + log bundle) to attach to the ticket. If anyone can grab 3-4 each, that'd be great.

leo: grabbing a couple now. tip: from a log line copy `trace_id` then run: `curl -s "https://tempo.internal/api/traces/${TRACE_ID}" | jq .` to fetch raw trace JSON (need SSO token or run from bastion with aws-vault).

maria: ops-bot just created a runbook stub: <https://runbooks.redwood/internal/kvcache-timeout> with triage steps and dashboard links. ops-bot: can you add link to the alert policy too?

ops-bot: Runbook created and linked to alert policy `ingress-502-rate` (policy id: rp-224). Added checklist: collect 10 traces, check prefix-cache hit rate, verify kernel/mem pressure.

denise: I'll open the alert debounce PR: https://git.redwood/company/infra/alerts/pull/312 — setting to 3m and adding a temporary note. We'll roll back when we confirm root cause.

aj: perfect. I'll grab 4 traces and attach to the PR comment. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

leo: FYI — if you see the pattern where 502s spike but backend response looks normal, check the prefix/KV cache eviction rates (metric `prefix_cache.evictions`) — high evictions correlate with these timeouts.

maria: adding that metric to the runbook now.

aj: great — feel free to ping me if you want me to annotate traces or screenshots for the ticket.
